[ELA 11/2 | Unit 3: Another View Session 3-5, Learning Target] I can identify key story elements from the beginning, middle, and end of a story, explain different characters' perspectives, describe how the conflict is resolved, and use introductory words and phrases to organize my writing.
[ELA 11/2 | Vocabulary] Perspective · Character · Setting · Story Components · Plot · Conflict · Resolution · Beginning · Middle · End · Textual Evidence · Introductory Transitions · Sequence · Compare · Contrast
[ELA 11/2 | Graphic Organizer] 11/4 Character Perspective Chart pg 32-33 / 11/5 Understand Story Elements pg. 44 / 11/6 Understand Story Elements pg. 59
[ELA 11/2 | Friday 11/6 Session 5 Do Now] What is the problem in the first part of Surely, Surely Marisol Rainey?
[M 11/2 | November 2-5, 2026] Lesson 12 - Multiplication and Division Facts
[M 11/2 | Standard] 3.PAR.3.2 Represent single digit multiplication and division facts using a variety of strategies. Explain the relationship between multiplication and division.
